 pin PINNED POST downArrow Go to latest 5h ago 10.35AM WATCH: Marnus falls for a duck
 Lachlan Harper shares Share post 23m ago 4.04PM Thanks for joining us!
 Lachlan Harper shares Share post That’ll do from us. Australia finish in a strong position.
 We’ll catch you next time. 
 29m ago 3.59PM That’s stumps
 Lachlan Harper shares Share post Australia finishes the day in front!
 The lead is one solitary run with the score 4-330. 
 Josh Inglis will come back tomorrow hoping for a ton with 85 to his name. Alex Carey has 51. 
 Advertisement 48m ago 3.39PM We’re approaching stumps
 Lachlan Harper shares Share post We have around 20 minutes until stumps. 
 Earlier, Josh Inglis survived a review for lbw off Kagiso Rabada’s bowling. It was given not out but the South Africans thought they had him.
 The replay showed it was going way over the stumps and the review was lost. 
 Australia is 4-298 and trail by 31. 
 1h ago 3.13PM Inglis reaches a milestone
 Lachlan Harper shares Share post Josh Inglis has moved to 50 off 76 balls. 
 What an important innings this has been with the game in the balance. 
 He was a late call-up too after Steve Smith’s injury. 
 1h ago 3.03PM Harmer looking very dangerous
 Lachlan Harper shares Share post This match is in a good spot here.
 The day is starting to wind down and now Simon Harmer is well and truly in the match.
 He’s had Alex Carey failing to get his reverse sweep going successfully and just beat Josh Inglis between bat and pad. Unfortunately for Harmer, it beat the stumps too. 
 1h ago 2.32PM Australia’s chase now under three figures
 Lachlan Harper shares Share post It’s been a patient and careful partnership from Alex Carey and Josh Inglis. 
 Australia now trails by 99 runs after a Josh Inglis shot went agonisingly close to point. 
 A life for Inglis. 
 Australia is 4-230. 
 2h ago 1.36PM Time for more cricket
 Lachlan Harper shares Share post We’re back from tea and Corbin Bosch is on the field. 
 That means Marco Jansen is off with a stomach issue. Could be a problem for South Africa. 
 3h ago 1.16PM We’re going to a break
 Lachlan Harper shares Share post This Test is in a brilliant spot. We have a match on our hands.
 Right now Australia is 4-191 with Inglis on 5 and Carey has 1. 
 You get the feeling this innings will end up at around even, but who knows.
 3h ago 1.03PM Now Green’s gone, Australia in trouble
 Lachlan Harper shares Share post The Proteas have struck twice!
 Cameron Green is walking off after a brilliant 65 and Marco Jansen is turning it all around. 
 “This is a huge blow,” Simon Katich said on SuperSport.
 Jansen went over the wicket and pushed the ball across Green. He edged it and Simon Harmer took the catch in the slips. Harmer certainly looked surprised too. 
 It’s 4-185. Big responsibility here for Josh Inglis and Alex Carey. 
 3h ago 12.54PM Has Renshaw survived again?
 Lachlan Harper shares Share post South Africa is up and about after a play and miss from Matt Renshaw off Marco Jansen’s bowling. 
 The Proteas are convinced he edged it but Renshaw stood his ground and it was given not out. They went straight upstairs.
 The ultra edge shows Renshaw has hit it and he’s gone for 74!
 That’s 100 Test wickets for Jansen.
 We have a Test on our hands here!
 Ultra edge for Matt Renshaw.  SuperSport
